lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular maxima localized on the mid-lateral flank; visible as roughly parallel vertical columns containing 3 to 5 discrete nodes each.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical regions of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular maxima, forming a localized grid-coordinate system across the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature positioned in the dorsal-lateral transition zone, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with lower pixel intensity on the ventral side of the ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density clustering of smaller, lower-intensity white nodes distinct from the larger flank constellation.
